items.title: 黃仁勳聽證會前夕添變數！Muddy Waters放空輝達、追問前高層與美超微晶片分配疑雲
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Faces New Variables Ahead of Hearing! Muddy Waters Shorts Nvidia, Questions Former Execs and AMD Chip Allocation Cloud
paras: 做空機構Muddy Waters披露放空輝達(NVDA-US)倉位，並公開質疑輝達前高層Ajay K. Puri與美超微電腦(SMCI-US)前首席業務增長官(CGO)Cenly Chen之間是否存在關聯，令這家晶片巨頭面臨新一輪外部壓力。
Muddy Waters 週二(17日)在社交平台X上發布貼文，指出該機構已建立輝達放空部位。
貼文指出，在2024年至2026年間，一位名叫Cenly Chen（在某些照片標籤中被稱為Cenly Puri）的女性，多次與輝達前高層Ajay K. Puri在公開場合被拍到同框。
Muddy Waters提出的核心疑問是：這位與Puri關係密切的女性，是否就是曾在美超微擔任首席業務增長官(CGO)的Cenly Chen？
這項披露發生於輝達動盪時期。執行長黃仁勳於11月12日辭職，並已同意於12月1日就相關問題回應三個眾議院委員會的質詢；輝達總法律顧問Tim Teter則定於次日出席。
要理解Muddy Waters為何緊盯這條線索，必須先看看這兩位人物在各自公司的分量：Ajay K. Puri在2026年6月離職前，擔任輝達全球業務營運執行副總裁(EVP of Worldwide Field Operations)。
Muddy Waters指出，Puri當時很可能是輝達內部僅次於黃仁勳和財務長Colette Kress的「三號人物」。在2024至2026財年間，他的總薪酬甚至略高於財務長Kress。即使在今年6月卸下該職務後，他仍繼續擔任輝達的高級顧問。
至於美超微前首席業務增長官Cenly Chen，正是負責管理美超微向輝達採購GPU晶片的核心人物，並且「決定如何將這些輝達GPU分配給美超微的客戶」。她已於2026年4月底或5月初離開美超微。
如果輝達的「首席銷售官」和美超微的「首席採購與分配官」之間存在未披露的密切關係，無疑將引發市場對兩家公司交易透明度的重大疑慮。
一邊是掌握輝達晶片出貨大權的高層，一邊是被指稱涉及相關安排的美超微前高層。在這個節骨眼上，Muddy Waters拋出的「高層關係疑雲」，無疑為即將到來的聽證會增添極為敏感的議題。
按照日程安排，剛辭去執行長職務的黃仁勳已同意於12月1日出席三個眾議院委員會的聽證會並回答質詢。緊接著在12月2日，輝達總法律顧問Tim Teter也將出庭作證。
paras_en: Short‑seller Muddy Waters disclosed a short position in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and publicly questioned whether former Nvidia executive Ajay K. Puri and former AMD (SMCI‑US) chief growth officer Cenly Chen have any connection, putting the chip giant under a new wave of external pressure.
Muddy Waters posted on X on Tuesday (the 17th) that the firm has established a short position in Nvidia.

The post noted that between 2024 and 2026, a woman named Cenly Chen (identified in some photo tags as Cenly Puri) was photographed multiple times together with former Nvidia executive Ajay K. Puri at public events.
Muddy Waters’ core question is whether this woman, who is close to Puri, is the same person who served as chief growth officer (CGO) at AMD, Cenly Chen.

The disclosure comes during a turbulent period for Nvidia. CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12 and has agreed to respond to three House committees on December 1; Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter is scheduled to appear the following day.

To understand why Muddy Waters is focusing on this lead, one must look at the stature of the two individuals at their respective companies: Ajay K. Puri, before leaving in June 2026, was EVP of Worldwide Field Operations at Nvidia.

Muddy Waters points out that Puri was likely the third‑most senior person at Nvidia after Huang and CFO Colette Kress. In fiscal years 2024‑2026 his total compensation was even slightly higher than CFO Kress’s. Even after stepping down from the role in June this year, he remains a senior advisor to Nvidia.

As for former AMD chief growth officer Cenly Chen, she was the key person responsible for managing AMD’s procurement of Nvidia GPU chips and “deciding how to allocate those Nvidia GPUs to AMD’s customers.” She left AMD at the end of April or early May 2026.

If an undisclosed close relationship exists between Nvidia’s “chief sales officer” and AMD’s “chief procurement and allocation officer,” it would undoubtedly raise serious market concerns about the transparency of the two companies’ transactions.

On one side is the senior executive who controls Nvidia’s chip shipments; on the other is the former AMD senior executive alleged to be involved in related arrangements. At this critical moment, Muddy Waters’ “executive‑relationship cloud” adds a highly sensitive issue to the upcoming hearings.

According to the schedule, the newly resigned CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to attend the three House committee hearings on December 1 and answer questions. Immediately after, on December 2, Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter will also testify in court.

items.title: 渾水做空輝達！追問前高階主管與美超微前主管之間的關係
items.title_en: Short Seller Muddy Waters Targets Nvidia! Probing the Connection Between Former Senior Executive and Former Super Micro Executive
paras: 做空機構渾水研究 (Muddy Waters Research) 週二 (17 日) 揭露持有輝達 (NVDA-US) 空頭部位，並追問曾與輝達前高層普里 (Ajay K. Puri) 公開合照的女子，是否就是美超微 (SMCI-US) 前資深副總裁 Cenly Chen。照片中女子的身分尚未獲獨立證實。
普里是外界點名的輝達執行長可能接班人選之一。輝達目前由財務長克瑞斯 (Colette Kress) 兼任臨時執行長，尚未公布正式人選。
渾水做空消息傳出之際，輝達公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報，單季營收達 1,158 億美元，年增 103%。
渾水援引美超微股東訴訟 追問合照女子身分
渾水指出，2024 年至 2026 年間，普里曾與一名女子多次公開同框，部分照片將她標註為「Cenly Puri」。渾水據此追問，照片中的女子是否就是美超微股東訴訟提及的 Cenly Chen。
渾水援引今年 10 月提交的美超微股東集體訴訟起訴狀指出，原告主張，Cenly Chen 任職美超微期間負責向輝達採購繪圖處理器 (GPU)，並決定晶片如何分配給客戶。訴狀也援引前員工說法，指她應知悉美超微涉嫌違法的銷售活動。這些主張尚未獲法院認定。
美國司法部今年 3 月在另一起刑事案件中起訴 3 名與美超微有關的人士，指控他們涉嫌透過一家東南亞公司，將受美國出口管制的 AI 伺服器轉運至中國。
檢方指出，該東南亞公司在 2024 年至 2025 年間採購約 25 億美元的伺服器。光是 2025 年 4 月下旬至 5 月中旬，就有至少約 5.1 億美元的伺服器涉嫌遭違法轉運至中國。普里與 Cenly Chen 均未被列為該案被告。
普里任職輝達 21 年 8 月卸下全球業務主管職務
輝達今年 7 月向 SEC 提交的文件顯示，普里於 6 月 28 日通知公司有意卸任。輝達當時表示，預計由他留任資深顧問、協助交接。8 月的申報文件確認，普里於 8 月 24 日正式卸下全球業務營運執行副總裁職務，原職由曾在微軟 (MSFT-US) 任職 26 年的帕克 (Nicholas Parker) 接任。
輝達今年 2 月申報的年報顯示，普里當時為 71 歲。他擁有明尼蘇達大學電機工程學士、加州理工學院電機工程碩士及哈佛商學院企管碩士 (MBA) 學位。
加入輝達前，他在昇陽電腦 (Sun Microsystems) 任職 22 年，曾任日本子公司總裁、全球軟體與技術銷售副總裁及亞太區資深副總裁，更早曾在惠普、德州儀器及博思艾倫顧問公司工作。
普里於 2005 年加入輝達，出任全球銷售資深副總裁，2009 年升任全球業務營運執行副總裁，負責全球銷售、業務拓展、合作夥伴關係、解決方案工程及客戶支援。他在輝達任職 21 年，歷經公司從以遊戲顯示卡聞名，到成為全球 AI 基礎設施主要供應商的過程。
黃仁勳坦承婚外情後，《WIRED》引述兩名知情人士報導，黃仁勳早在 2025 年 10 月就已與危機公關公司 Heller 合作。根據申報資料，普里於 2026 年 1 月 7 日、21 日及 3 月 10 日、18 日分四次賣出輝達股票，合計 100 萬股，成交金額約 1.83 億美元。
輝達董事會無意讓黃仁勳復職
輝達董事會已接受創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 辭任執行長。董事長瓊斯 (Harvey Jones) 週二在法說會上表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳復職。
另據《華爾街日報》報導，美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 正對輝達展開民事調查，焦點是公司對外揭露的資訊是否誤導投資人。
美國眾議院情報委員會、外交委員會及中國問題特別委員會證實，黃仁勳與輝達法務長提特 (Tim Teter) 已同意分別於 12 月 1 日及 2 日接受有逐字紀錄的閉門訪談。
paras_en: Muddy Waters Research disclosed on Tuesday (the 17th) that it holds a short position in Nvidia (NVDA-US) and asked whether the woman publicly photographed with former Nvidia senior executive Ajay K. Puri is the former senior vice president of Super Micro (SMCI-US), Cenly Chen. The woman's identity in the photo has not been independently verified.

Puri is one of the candidates publicly named as a possible successor to Nvidia's CEO. Nvidia is currently being run on an interim basis by CFO Colette Kress, who has not yet announced a permanent CEO.
As Muddy Waters' short‑selling report emerged, Nvidia released its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results, reporting quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.
Muddy Waters cited a Super Micro shareholder lawsuit to question the identity of the woman in the photo.

Muddy Waters noted that between 2024 and 2026, Puri appeared publicly multiple times with a woman, some photos labeling her as “Cenly Puri.” The firm asked whether the woman is the Cenly Chen mentioned in the Super Micro shareholder litigation.

Muddy Waters referenced a collective lawsuit filed in October against Super Micro, in which plaintiffs allege that while at Super Micro, Cenly Chen was responsible for procuring GPUs from Nvidia and deciding how chips were allocated to customers. The complaint also quotes former employees saying she should have been aware of Super Micro's alleged illegal sales activities. Those allegations have not been adjudicated.

In March this year, the U.S. Department of Justice indicted three individuals linked to Super Micro in a separate criminal case, accusing them of using a Southeast Asian company to ship AI servers subject to U.S. export controls to China.

Prosecutors said the Southeast Asian firm purchased about $2.5 billion worth of servers between 2024 and 2025. From late April to mid‑May 2025 alone, roughly $510 million of servers were allegedly illegally rerouted to China. Neither Puri nor Cenly Chen were named as defendants in that case.
Puri stepped down from his role as head of global business on August 21 after 21 years at Nvidia.

Nvidia’s July filing with the SEC shows that Puri notified the company of his intent to resign on June 28. Nvidia said he would remain as a senior advisor to assist with the transition. An August filing confirmed that Puri formally vacated the position of executive vice president of global business operations on August 24, with the role passing to Nicholas Parker, who spent 26 years at Microsoft.

Nvidia’s February annual report listed Puri as 71 years old at the time. He holds a B.S. in electrical engineering from the University of Minnesota, an M.S. in electrical engineering from Caltech, and an MBA from Harvard Business School.

Before joining Nvidia, he spent 22 years at Sun Microsystems, serving as president of its Japan subsidiary, senior vice president of global software and technology sales, and senior vice president for the Asia‑Pacific region, and earlier worked at HP, Texas Instruments and Booz Allen Hamilton.

Puri joined Nvidia in 2005 as senior vice president of global sales, was promoted in 2009 to executive vice president of global business operations, overseeing worldwide sales, business development, partner relationships, solution engineering and customer support. He spent 21 years at Nvidia, witnessing its evolution from a gaming graphics‑card company to a leading global AI infrastructure supplier.

After Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, WIRED quoted two insiders reporting that Huang had already engaged crisis‑PR firm Heller in October 2025. According to filing data, Puri sold Nvidia stock in four transactions on Jan 7, Jan 21, Mar 10 and Mar 18 2026, totaling 1 million shares for about $183 million.
Nvidia’s board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO
Nvidia’s board has accepted Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO. Chairman Harvey Jones told analysts on Tuesday that the board does not plan to bring Huang back.
The Wall Street Journal reported that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has opened a civil investigation into Nvidia, focusing on whether the company’s public disclosures misled investors.

The House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China‑focused select committees confirmed that Jensen Huang and Nvidia’s general counsel Tim Teter have agreed to give recorded, closed‑door interviews on Dec 1 and Dec 2 respectively.

items.title: 標普500三年大漲80%仍不貴？預估本益比降至3年低點、企業獲利預期成關鍵風險
items.title_en: S&P 500 Up 80% in Three Years Still Not Expensive? Forecast P/E Falls to Three‑Year Low, Corporate Earnings Outlook Becomes Key Risk
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）產業帶動大型科技股走強，美股過去三年表現亮眼，標普500指數自2023年11月初以來累計上漲約80%。不過，儘管股價大幅攀升，從預估本益比來看，標普500指數估值卻已回落至三年來相對低檔，甚至低於過去5年及10年的平均水準。
根據《The Motley Fool》報導，FactSet數據顯示，11月5日美國期中選舉後的市場拋售潮期間，標普500指數的預估本益比一度降至17.7倍。
目前，這項數值明顯低於該指數過去5年及10年的平均預估本益比，分別為19.8倍及19.1倍，也是自2023年11月1日以來的最低水準。
然而，分析指出，投資人不宜因此預期未來三年股市還能再複製過去約80%的漲幅。預估本益比雖然看似便宜，關鍵在於其計算基礎仰賴分析師對未來獲利的預估，而目前市場對企業獲利成長的期待，已明顯高於年初。

獲利預期上修　推動預估本益比降至17.7倍

預估本益比是以股價除以預估獲利計算，股價可以直接觀察，但獲利數字則取決於分析師對企業未來表現的預測，因此可能隨新資訊出現而大幅調整。
今年以來，企業獲利表現優於預期，促使分析師調高未來獲利預估，因此即使同期指數仍持續上漲，標普500指數預估本益比從年初約22倍降至目前不到18倍。
去年第三季至今年第二季，企業實際獲利平均比分析師預估高出13.8%。至於今年第三季，目前公布財報的企業獲利約比預期高出2.7%，低於通常的超預期幅度，但這也與分析師原本就抱持較高期待有關，市場目前預估第三季企業獲利成長約30%。
這種高預期也延續至第四季。分析師對第四季獲利成長的預期為28.4%，明年第一季則略降至19.5%。
由於部分大型企業今年有一次性投資收益，明年第二季將面臨較高的比較基期，分析師對該季的獲利成長預測已降至僅3%。不過，分析師仍預期標普500指數成分企業2027年全年獲利將成長16.1%。
分析師今年初以來大幅上調獲利成長預期，進而壓低預估本益比。但最大的問題在於，未來獲利表現難以準確預測。
即使過去幾季企業獲利成績相當出色，採用實際財報數據計算的標普500指數歷史本益比仍約為25倍，高於過去5年及10年的平均值24.4倍與23.7倍。

AI成長機會與融資壓力　左右企業獲利前景

市場目前最大的疑問，是企業獲利能否達到分析師預期的高速成長。長期而言，股票投資人之所以能取得較高報酬，部分原因正是願意承擔未來獲利不確定性的風險。
部分人士認為，分析師仍低估了AI帶來的龐大成長機會。大型科技公司持續投入愈來愈多資金興建資料中心，隨著這些能夠創造收入的資產陸續投入營運，企業營收成長速度可能進一步加快。
另一方面，也有人認為，AI類股要進一步成長仍面臨重大阻礙，包括資本市場資金環境日益緊縮，以及監管機構施加的壓力增加。這些因素可能拖慢資料中心建設進度，甚至使營收成長停滯。
儘管大型AI類股對標普500指數整體獲利預期的影響最大，但指數中仍有數百家公司大致不受AI建設熱潮影響。
分析指出，當市場目光集中在AI題材時，願意深入研究個別企業及其獲利展望的投資人，或許能從中找到尚未受到充分重視的投資機會。
整體而言，標普500指數在過去三年大漲約80%後，預估本益比仍相對偏低，顯示股價相較市場預期獲利並未顯得昂貴。不過，與三年前相比，目前分析師對企業獲利成長的期待更高，一旦實際表現不如預期，股市也將面臨更大的失望風險。
paras_en: Benefiting from the AI‑driven rally in large‑cap tech stocks, U.S. equities have performed strongly over the past three years, with the S&P 500 index up roughly 80% since early November 2023. Yet despite the sharp price gains, the index’s forward price‑to‑earnings (P/E) ratio has slipped to a relatively low level for the past three years, even below the five‑year and ten‑year average levels.
According to The Motley Fool, FactSet data show that during the market sell‑off after the U.S. midterm elections on November 5, the S&P 500’s forward P/E briefly fell to 17.7 times.
That figure is now clearly lower than the index’s average forward P/E over the past five and ten years, which are 19.8× and 19.1× respectively, and it is the lowest level since November 1, 2023.

Analysts caution that investors should not assume the market can repeat the roughly 80% gain of the past three years. While the forward P/E looks cheap, it is based on analysts’ earnings forecasts, and market expectations for corporate profit growth are already markedly higher than at the start of the year.

Earnings outlook revisions drive the forward P/E down to 17.7×. The forward P/E is calculated as price divided by estimated earnings; price is observable, but earnings depend on analysts’ projections and can shift dramatically with new information.

So far this year, corporate earnings have outperformed expectations, prompting analysts to raise future earnings estimates. Consequently, even as the index continues to climb, the S&P 500’s forward P/E has fallen from about 22× at the start of the year to just under 18× now.

From Q3 2022 to Q2 2023, actual corporate earnings averaged 13.8% above analysts’ forecasts. In Q3 2023, companies that have reported so far are earning about 2.7% more than expected—below the usual surprise margin—but this reflects the already high expectations, with the market now projecting roughly 30% earnings growth for Q3.
That high expectation carries into Q4, where analysts forecast 28.4% earnings growth, easing to 19.5% in Q1 2024.

Because some large firms enjoyed one‑off investment gains this year, the base for comparison will be higher in Q2 2024, and analysts have trimmed the growth forecast for that quarter to just 3%. Nonetheless, they still expect S&P 500 constituents to post 16.1% full‑year earnings growth in 2027.

Analysts have sharply lifted earnings‑growth forecasts since the start of the year, pulling the forward P/E lower. The biggest issue, however, is that future earnings performance is hard to predict accurately.

Even though corporate earnings have been strong in recent quarters, the historically calculated S&P 500 P/E based on actual filings remains around 25×, above the five‑year and ten‑year averages of 24.4× and 23.7× respectively.

The market’s biggest question now is whether companies can achieve the rapid earnings growth analysts anticipate. Over the long run, equity investors earn higher returns partly by bearing the risk of uncertain future profits.

Some argue analysts are still underestimating the massive growth opportunities AI brings. Large tech firms are pouring ever‑greater capital into data‑center construction, and as these revenue‑generating assets come online, corporate revenue growth could accelerate further.

Others contend that AI‑related stocks still face major headwinds, including tightening capital‑market conditions and increasing regulatory pressure, which could slow data‑center build‑outs and even stall revenue growth.
Although large AI stocks have the biggest impact on the S&P 500’s overall earnings outlook, hundreds of companies in the index are largely insulated from the AI construction boom.

Analysts note that when market attention is fixated on AI themes, investors willing to dig into individual companies and their earnings prospects may uncover opportunities that have not yet been fully appreciated.

Overall, after the S&P 500’s roughly 80% surge over the past three years, the forward P/E remains relatively low, indicating that prices are not expensive relative to market earnings expectations. However, analysts now expect higher earnings growth than three years ago, so if actual results fall short, the market could face heightened disappointment risk.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美元和美債殖利率雙升 黃金仍陷一年低點
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Dollar and US Treasury Yields Rise, Gold Still Stuck at One‑Year Low
paras: 黃金周二(17日)大致持平在一年低點，美元回升加上美債殖利率攀高都打擊黃金需求，投資人也正等待聯準會(Fed)上次會議紀錄，以推敲升息前景的規模和時機。

黃金現貨下跌0.07%，報每盎司3853.36美元，難以從周一觸及的3830.74美元反彈。
美國12月黃金期貨收高0.2%，報每盎司3864.2美元。


CMS Prime營運長Terri-Leigh Bennett說：「市場機制殘酷而簡單：美國10年期公債殖利率被推升至約5.14%，美元則攀抵19個月來新高。面對5%的無風險票息，不會產生收益的資產根本沒有勝算。」
他進一部解釋：「再加上人工智慧(AI)股票遭遇拋售……黃金因此受到雙重打擊，因為當市場急於籌措現金時，黃金首先被視為抵押品，其次才是避險資產。」
美元雖然回落，但仍徘徊在19個月高點附近。市場預期Fed將採取更積極的升息行動，也推升指標10年期美債殖利率。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，目前市場預期Fed 12月升息1碼(25個基點)的機率達96%。在決策官員發表偏鷹派談話後，市場也開始評估升息2碼(50個基點)的小幅可能性。
聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)周二表示，Fed可能需要多次升息，才能抑制居高不下的通膨，並應儘早採取行動，避免問題進一步惡化。
Fed預定周三公布10月會議紀錄。
Bennett補充說：「如果10月會議紀錄顯示決策官員之間確實存在分歧，或有委員對經濟成長的憂慮不亞於對物價的擔心，那麼市場對升息2碼的預期就會消退，美元走軟也將帶動金價出現紓緩性反彈。」
利率上升通常會降低黃金吸引力，因為黃金本身不孳息。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀上漲0.7%，報每盎司47.36美元，前一交易日曾觸及2025年10月底以來最低水準。
現貨白金下下跌1.4%，報每盎司1,428.80美元。
現貨鈀金上漲0.3%，報每盎司971.58美元。
paras_en: Gold was essentially flat on Tuesday (the 17th) at its one‑year low, as a stronger dollar and higher US Treasury yields dented demand, while investors await the Fed’s minutes from the last meeting to gauge the size and timing of any further rate hikes.

Spot gold fell 0.07% to $3,853.36 per ounce, failing to rebound from Monday’s low of $3,830.74. December US gold futures rose 0.2% to $3,864.20 per ounce. CMS Prime COO Terri‑Leigh Bennett said: “The market mechanism is brutal and simple: the US 10‑year Treasury yield has been pushed up to about 5.14%, and the dollar has climbed to a 19‑month high. With a risk‑free rate near 5%, assets that generate no yield have no chance of winning.”
She added: “On top of that, AI stocks are being sold off… Gold is hit from two sides because when the market scrambles for cash, gold is first used as collateral and only then as a safe‑haven asset.”

The dollar, while having slipped a bit, still hovers near its 19‑month peak. Markets expect the Fed to take a more aggressive rate‑hiking stance, which also pushes the benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield higher.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now assigns a 96% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter point (25 basis points) in December. After hawkish comments from policymakers, the market also began to price a small chance of a two‑quarter‑point (50‑bp) hike.
St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said on Tuesday that the Fed may need multiple hikes to curb persistently high inflation and should act promptly to prevent the problem from worsening further.
The Fed is scheduled to release the minutes of its October meeting on Wednesday.

Bennett added: “If the October minutes show genuine disagreement among policymakers, or if any member worries about economic growth as much as they do about inflation, expectations for a two‑quarter‑point hike will fade, the dollar will weaken and gold could see a modest rebound.”
Higher rates usually reduce gold’s appeal because gold itself yields no interest.

Other precious‑metal trades: Spot silver rose 0.7% to $47.36 per ounce, after hitting its lowest level since the end of October 2025 on the previous session. Spot platinum fell 1.4% to $1,428.80 per ounce. Spot palladium gained 0.3% to $971.58 per ounce.

items.title: AI重寫半導體產業！三星記憶體漲價270%、蘋果改簽5年長約、消費市場承壓
items.title_en: AI Rewrites the Semiconductor Industry! Samsung Memory Prices Jump 270%, Apple Switches to 5-Year Long-Term Contracts, Consumer Market Under Pressure
paras: 三星電子第三季記憶體晶片平均售價較2025年均價暴漲約270%，AI資料中心需求持續排擠手機與PC所需的記憶體產能，甚至連三星自家手機部門也難以倖免，行動記憶體晶片採購價格上漲約263%。在全球記憶體工廠滿載運轉之際，蘋果正考慮改變採購策略，透過多年期長約提前鎖定供應，顯示AI浪潮正重新改寫半導體產業的供需結構。
三星電子 (Samsung Electronics) 最新季度報告顯示，第三季記憶體晶片平均售價約為2025年全年平均價格的3.7倍，行動記憶體晶片價格也大幅攀升。這使三星儲存業務直接受惠於漲價，但旗下手機部門卻必須承擔更高的零組件成本，形成同一家公司內部一邊受惠、一邊承壓的局面。
供應緊張也反映在產能數據上。今年前9個月，三星電子與SK海力士 (SK hynix) 的記憶體晶片工廠產能利用率均達100%，顯示現有生產設施幾乎沒有閒置空間。三星在全球DRAM市場的市佔率也從去年的34.0%上升至約38.3%，進一步鞏固市場地位。
SK海力士11月17日公布的季度報告則顯示，今年1月至9月，來自單一外部客戶的營收合計達34.98兆韓元。據報導，該客戶為輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)，相關營收約為一年前的兩倍，反映AI晶片大廠對高效能記憶體的採購需求，已成為記憶體供應商的重要收入來源。
隨著亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)、Google母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭積極建置AI資料中心，記憶體廠優先將產能分配給高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 等伺服器產品，進一步壓縮行動DRAM及其他消費性記憶體的供應。手機與PC品牌因此必須提早安排採購，避免未來面臨缺貨及成本進一步上升的風險。
蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 正是其中之一。據報導，蘋果即將與三星電子簽訂DRAM長期供貨合約，預計自2027年上半年起生效，合約期間約4至5年，並設定最低供貨量，但最終價格仍將依未來市場狀況決定。
蘋果過去主要採用短期採購合約，每次續約時通常要求供應商降價，但在記憶體供應日益緊張的情況下，採購策略正出現轉變。蘋果近期也據報以較有利於供應商的條件，與SK海力士簽訂長期合約，顯示確保供貨的重要性已逐漸超越短期壓價。
面對供應緊張，三星電子與SK海力士也同步擴大資本支出。據報導，兩家公司今年前三季設備投資合計達88兆韓元，年增逾70%，創下歷史新高。隨著記憶體價格走高及產能利用率滿載，兩大廠商正加快設備投資，相關資金也將進一步流向半導體材料、零組件及設備供應商。
不過，記憶體市場並非所有產品都同步受惠於AI需求。最新產業預測已將2027年NAND總位元需求年增率從原先預估的22.6%下修至18.7%，降幅達3.2%。其中，客戶端SSD需求預測下調10%，行動NAND下調6.5%，企業級SSD則下調1.5%。
相較之下，DRAM需求展望略有改善，2027年總位元需求預測上調0.3%，主要受到伺服器與圖形DRAM需求支撐，抵銷行動及PC市場需求下修的影響。這也凸顯AI基礎設施投資正在改變記憶體市場結構，伺服器相關產品與消費性產品的景氣表現逐漸分化。
消費市場已開始對記憶體漲價作出反應，部分設備品牌為控制成本，正考慮降低手機與PC的記憶體及儲存容量配置。產業分析指出，消費市場需求疲軟的影響，已超過AI需求帶來的部分提振。
此外，隨著先進製程供應增加，以及QLC (四層單元) NAND技術採用擴大，分析人士預期NAND市場未來可能出現供應過剩，合約價格下跌時間也可能提前至2027年第二季，較先前預測早一個季度。這意味著目前記憶體價格飆漲的行情，未必能在所有產品線持續。
另一方面，AI產業的商業化速度也持續加快。OpenAI據報季度營收已達100億美元，短短三個月成長50%。財務長薩拉·弗萊爾 (Sarah Friar) 表示，公司在2026年仍面臨算力不足問題，必須在市場需求真正到來之前提前投入資本，以確保運算資源能跟上業務擴張。
弗萊爾也透露，OpenAI最新一輪融資後估值達1.25兆美元，廣告業務推出不到200天，累計收入已超過10億美元。廣告開始成為訂閱收入以外的另一項商業化來源，也讓OpenAI的營收模式逐漸從單純依賴用戶付費，擴展至企業廣告與商業服務。
然而，AI使用量的成長並非毫無限制。一項針對147個公開Codex檔案、為期一年的每日Token使用量分析發現，使用者導入AI代理後，Token消耗量最初快速攀升，但隨後便迅速趨於穩定，而且遠低於訂閱方案設定的使用上限。
這項觀察顯示，AI代理雖然能在初期帶動運算需求增加，但單一用戶的使用量未必會持續呈指數成長。未來AI算力需求能否維持高速擴張，可能更取決於新用戶增加，以及AI能否進一步進入企業日常工作流程，而非僅依靠既有用戶增加呼叫次數。
為擴大應用範圍，OpenAI正積極將產品導入專業產業。旗下ChatGPT醫療版新增更強大的電腦操作AI代理、臨床回答能力，以及超過20個醫療插件，讓AI不再只是提供資訊，而是進一步協助完成實際工作流程。
Abridge、Ambience、信諾 (The Cigna Group) (CI-US) 及西維斯健康 (CVS Health) (CVS-US) 等機構，已將OpenAI模型應用於事先授權、轉診、出院規劃及病患聯絡等工作。透過將醫療證據與AI操作能力整合至既有系統，醫療機構希望減少人員在不同軟體平台之間切換的時間，提升行政及臨床作業效率。
在AI晶片市場方面，輝達與超微半導體 (Advanced Micro Devices) (AMD-US) 則分別從AI訓練與推理效能切入，持續爭奪資料中心市場。
輝達11月16日公布MLPerf Training v6.1基準測試結果，在全部7項測試項目中均取得領先。首次亮相的Vera Rubin NVL72平台，每顆GPU的AI訓練速度較GB300系統最高提升至2倍，展現新一代平台在模型訓練方面的效能優勢。
超微半導體則將競爭焦點放在離線推理。公司11月12日公布，MI455X在DeepSeek-R1的MLPerf離線推理測試中，每顆GPU每秒可處理21,333個Token，較Vera Rubin NVL72高出30%。
超微半導體指出，效能差距主要來自系統資料頻寬。MI455X的HBM頻寬最高較Rubin GPU高20%，GPU之間的機架內互連頻寬也更高，有助於提升大型AI模型在推理工作負載下的Token處理能力。
不過，兩家公司公布的成績分別針對不同工作負載，不能直接視為全面性的效能排名。對需要大量模型訓練的客戶而言，輝達在7項基準測試中的領先具有優勢；若企業更重視離線推理吞吐量，超微半導體公布的MI455X測試結果，則有助於提高其在資料中心採購競標中的吸引力。
此外，超微半導體也推出成本較低的MI450X，每顆GPU配備288GB HBM4，運算效能、記憶體頻寬，以及機架內外互連能力均與MI455X相同，客戶可在Helios系統中選用。這代表超微半導體開始透過不同記憶體容量的產品組合，提供客戶更具彈性的採購選擇。
整體而言，AI產業的競爭已從GPU晶片本身，擴大至記憶體供應、資料中心建置、運算效率及企業應用等多個層面。AI需求推升HBM與DRAM價格，也讓手機及PC品牌面臨成本壓力；另一方面，OpenAI加速拓展企業工作流程，輝達與超微半導體則持續爭奪訓練及推理市場。隨著資本投入與供應鏈重新分配，AI產業下一階段的競爭關鍵，將不只是誰能提供更強大的晶片，也包括誰能取得足夠的記憶體、算力與實際商業需求。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics' average memory chip selling price in the third quarter surged about 270% compared with the 2025 average price, as AI data‑center demand continues to crowd out memory capacity needed for phones and PCs, even Samsung's own mobile division is not spared, with mobile memory chip procurement prices rising roughly 263%. With global memory factories running at full capacity, Apple is considering changing its procurement strategy by locking in supply through multi‑year long‑term contracts, showing that the AI wave is reshaping the semiconductor supply‑demand structure.

Samsung Electronics' latest quarterly report shows the third‑quarter average memory chip price was about 3.7 times the full‑year 2025 average, and mobile memory chip prices also climbed sharply. This lets Samsung's storage business benefit directly from the price hikes, while its phone division must bear higher component costs, creating a situation where one part of the same company benefits while another is under pressure.

Tight supply is also reflected in capacity data. In the first nine months of this year, both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix operated their memory chip factories at 100% capacity utilization, indicating virtually no idle space in existing facilities. Samsung’s share of the global DRAM market rose from 34.0% last year to about 38.3%, further cementing its market position.

SK Hynix’s November 17 quarterly report shows that from January to September this year, revenue from a single external customer totaled 34.98 trillion won. The customer was NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), and the related revenue was about twice that of a year earlier, reflecting the AI‑chip giant’s growing demand for high‑performance memory, which has become a major revenue source for memory suppliers.

As tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet, Google’s parent (GOOGL‑US), aggressively build AI data centers, memory makers prioritize capacity for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other server products, further squeezing supply of mobile DRAM and other consumer memory. Phone and PC brands therefore have to plan purchases early to avoid future shortages and further cost increases.

Apple (AAPL‑US) is one of those brands. Reports say Apple will sign a long‑term DRAM supply contract with Samsung Electronics, expected to take effect in the first half of 2027, lasting about four to five years, with a minimum supply volume but a final price to be set according to future market conditions.

Apple historically used short‑term purchase contracts, usually demanding price cuts at each renewal. With memory supply becoming increasingly tight, its procurement strategy is shifting. Apple has also recently signed a long‑term deal with SK Hynix on terms more favorable to the supplier, showing that securing supply is overtaking short‑term price pressure.

Facing tight supply, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are simultaneously expanding capital expenditures. Reports say the two companies’ equipment investment in the first three quarters of this year totalled 88 trillion won, up more than 70% year‑over‑year, a historic high. As memory prices rise and capacity utilization is maxed out, both firms are accelerating equipment spending, with funds flowing further to semiconductor materials, components and equipment suppliers.

However, not all memory products benefit equally from AI demand. The latest industry forecast has revised down the 2027 NAND total bit‑demand growth rate from the previously expected 22.6% to 18.7%, a 3.2‑point drop. Client‑side SSD demand is cut by 10%, mobile NAND by 6.5%, and enterprise SSD by 1.5%.

In contrast, the DRAM outlook is slightly better, with the 2027 total bit‑demand forecast nudged up by 0.3%, mainly supported by server and graphics DRAM demand, offsetting the downward revisions in mobile and PC markets. This highlights how AI‑infrastructure investment is reshaping memory market structure, creating a growing divergence between server‑related and consumer products.

The consumer market has already begun reacting to memory price hikes; some device brands, to control costs, are considering reducing memory and storage capacities in phones and PCs. Analysts note that the impact of weak consumer demand now outweighs the modest boost from AI demand.

Moreover, with increased supply of advanced processes and wider adoption of QLC (quad‑level‑cell) NAND technology, analysts expect a possible future oversupply in the NAND market, with contract price declines potentially arriving as early as Q2 2027, a quarter earlier than previously forecast. This suggests the current surge in memory prices may not persist across all product lines.

On the other hand, the commercialization pace of the AI industry continues to accelerate. OpenAI reportedly posted quarterly revenue of $10 billion, a 50% increase in just three months. CFO Sarah Friar said the company still faces compute‑capacity constraints in 2026 and must invest capital ahead of true market demand to ensure computing resources keep up with business expansion.

Friar also disclosed that after OpenAI’s latest financing round, its valuation reached $1.25 trillion, and its advertising business, launched less than 200 days ago, has already generated over $1 billion in cumulative revenue. Advertising is becoming a second revenue stream beyond subscriptions, broadening OpenAI’s model from pure user‑pay to include enterprise ads and commercial services.

Nevertheless, AI usage growth is not unlimited. An analysis of daily token usage over a year across 147 public Codex files found that after users introduced AI agents, token consumption spiked quickly at first but then stabilized at levels far below the usage caps set by subscription plans.

This observation shows that while AI agents can drive an initial surge in compute demand, a single user’s consumption may not keep growing exponentially. Future AI compute demand will likely depend more on acquiring new users and integrating AI deeper into enterprise workflows rather than merely increasing call frequency from existing users.

To broaden its application scope, OpenAI is actively embedding its products into professional industries. The ChatGPT medical edition now adds more powerful computer‑operated AI agents, clinical answering capabilities, and over 20 medical plugins, moving AI from merely providing information to actually assisting real‑world workflows.

Organizations such as Abridge, Ambience, The Cigna Group (CI‑US) and CVS Health (CVS‑US) have already applied OpenAI models to tasks like prior authorization, referrals, discharge planning and patient outreach. By integrating medical evidence with AI operational ability into existing systems, healthcare providers aim to cut time spent switching between software platforms and boost administrative and clinical efficiency.
In the AI chip market, NVIDIA and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD‑US) are each focusing on AI training and inference performance, respectively, continuing their battle for data‑center market share.

NVIDIA announced on November 16 its MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark results, leading in all seven test categories. Its newly unveiled Vera Rubin NVL72 platform delivered up to twice the AI training speed per GPU compared with the previous GB300 system, showcasing the next‑gen platform’s advantage in model training.

AMD, meanwhile, is concentrating on offline inference. On November 12 the company reported that its MI455X achieved 21,333 tokens per second per GPU in the DeepSeek‑R1 MLPerf offline inference test, about 30% faster than the Vera Rubin NVL72.

AMD explained that the performance gap stems mainly from system data bandwidth. The MI455X’s HBM bandwidth is up to 20% higher than the Rubin GPU’s, and its intra‑rack interconnect bandwidth is also greater, helping large AI models process more tokens under inference workloads.

However, the two companies’ results target different workloads and cannot be taken as a universal performance ranking. For customers needing heavy model training, NVIDIA’s lead across the seven benchmarks is advantageous; for those prioritizing offline inference throughput, AMD’s MI455X results enhance its appeal in data‑center procurement contests.

AMD also introduced a lower‑cost MI450X, equipped with 288 GB of HBM4 per GPU and offering the same compute performance, memory bandwidth, and intra‑rack connectivity as the MI455X, allowing customers to choose it within Helios systems. This shows AMD is providing more flexible purchasing options through varied memory‑capacity product mixes.

Overall, competition in the AI industry has expanded beyond the GPU chip itself to encompass memory supply, data‑center construction, compute efficiency and enterprise applications. AI‑driven demand is lifting HBM and DRAM prices, pressuring phone and PC brands with higher costs; meanwhile OpenAI is accelerating its push into enterprise workflows, and NVIDIA and AMD continue to vie for training and inference markets. As capital投入 and supply‑chain realignment progress, the next phase of AI competition will hinge not only on who offers the most powerful chips but also on who can secure sufficient memory, compute power and real‑world commercial demand.

items.title: 輝達董事長財報會議明言：「無意讓黃仁勳重任執行長」
items.title_en: Nvidia Chairman Says at Earnings Call He Has No Intention to Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事長哈維瓊斯 (Harvey Jones) 週二 (17 日) 在財報會議開場時明言，董事會一致同意接受共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長，無意讓他復職。
黃仁勳週二稍早才在辭職後首度公開表態，稱若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，他願意回鍋重任執行長。
瓊斯接著於財報會議中表示，黃仁勳是在揭露與公司「行為準則、標準及企業文化規範不符」的個人行為後請辭。他說：「輝達董事會一致同意接受他的辭呈，無意讓黃仁勳重任執行長。」
瓊斯也表示，輝達不會在這場法說會上討論黃仁勳請辭的相關情況或仍在進行的調查，也不會回答相關提問。
他說：「董事會將在適當時機進一步說明。」
黃仁勳離任後首份財報超預期 資料中心營收翻倍
這是黃仁勳上週請辭後，輝達首次公布財報，由財務長兼代理執行長克瑞斯 (Colette Kress) 說明營運表現。
輝達會計年度第三季營收達 1,158.4 億美元，為去年同期 570 億美元的兩倍多，高於市場預期的 1,091 億美元。調整後每股純益為 2.68 美元，也高於市場預期的 2.48 美元。
作為輝達主要成長引擎，資料中心營收較去年同期翻倍，達 1,076 億美元，高於市場預期的 1,018.7 億美元。
調整後毛利率為 74.9%，優於市場預期的 74%。輝達表示，毛利率較前一季下滑，主要與 Rubin GPU 擴大生產有關。
輝達預估第四季營收約 1,300 億美元，年增約 90%，高於市場預期的 1,251 億美元。
克瑞斯也將截至 2028 年 1 月的會計年度成長預期由 70% 上調至 75%。她表示，Vera Rubin 起步強勁，產品開發時程按計畫推進。
美國收緊晶片管制 輝達財測未計入中國資料中心運算營收
美國商務部週一 (16 日) 宣布收緊先進 AI 晶片管制，進一步限制中國企業透過海外資料中心租用輝達晶片。
輝達在財報說明中重申，本次財測未將來自中國的資料中心運算業務營收納入估算。
輝達週二收跌 0.44%，報每股 155.46 美元，連四個交易日累計下跌約 11%。財報及財測雙雙優於預期後，股價盤後上漲約 2%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) Chairman Harvey Jones said on Tuesday the board unanimously agreed to accept co‑founder Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO and has no intention to reinstate him.

Huang earlier on Tuesday, after resigning, publicly stated that if the board believes his return would be in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, he is willing to come back as CEO.

Jones then said at the earnings call that Huang resigned after personal conduct was found to be inconsistent with the company's code of conduct, standards and corporate culture. He added, "The Nvidia board unanimously agrees to accept his resignation and has no intention to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO."
Jones also said Nvidia will not discuss the circumstances of Huang's resignation or the ongoing investigation during this earnings call, nor will it answer related questions.
He said, "The board will provide further details at an appropriate time."
Huang's first earnings report after stepping down exceeds expectations, with data‑center revenue doubling.
This was the first earnings release after Huang's resignation last week, presented by CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress on operating performance.

Nvidia reported third‑quarter fiscal revenue of $115.84 billion, more than double last year’s $57.0 billion and above the $109.1 billion consensus. Adjusted earnings were $2.68 per share, beating the $2.48 estimate.
Data‑center revenue, Nvidia’s main growth engine, more than doubled year‑over‑year to $107.6 billion, topping the $101.87 billion forecast.
Adjusted gross margin was 74.9%, ahead of the 74% outlook. Nvidia said the margin dip from the prior quarter was mainly due to expanded production of the Rubin GPU.
Nvidia forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of about $130 billion, roughly a 90% year‑over‑year increase, above the $125.1 billion consensus.
Kress also raised the fiscal‑year‑ending January 2028 growth outlook from 70% to 75%, noting a strong start for Vera Rubin and that product development is on schedule.
U.S. Tightens Chip Controls; Nvidia’s Forecast Excludes China Data‑Center Revenue
The U.S. Commerce Department announced on Monday tighter controls on advanced AI chips, further restricting Chinese firms from accessing Nvidia chips via overseas data centers.
Nvidia reiterated in its earnings commentary that the current forecast does not include revenue from China data‑center computing services.
Nvidia shares fell 0.44% on Tuesday to $155.46, down about 11% over four trading days, but rose roughly 2% in after‑hours trading as both earnings and guidance beat expectations.

items.title: 〈財報〉輝達Q3超預期財測強盤後走揚 董事會無意讓黃仁勳回任
items.title_en: <Earnings> Nvidia Q3 Beats Expectations, Shares Rise After Strong Outlook; Board Unwilling to Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
paras: AI晶片龍頭輝(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)周二(17日)盤後公布2027會計年度第三季(截至10/25)財報，獲利與營收雙雙優於市場預期，並給出強勁財測。這是共同創辦人黃仁勳上週辭去執行長職務後首次公布財報。消息公布後，輝達股價在盤後交易上漲約 2%。
輝達首任董事長 Harvey Jones 在財報電話會議一開始即表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：1,158.4 億美元 v.s. 1,091 億美元
調整後EPS：2.68 美元 v.s. 2.48 美元
資料中心營收：1,076 億美元，較去年同期成長 110%
Vera Rubin NVL72 已正式出貨


輝達表示，營收較去年同期 570 億美元增加逾一倍，顯示核心資料中心業務持續強勁。公司預估，本季營收將成長約 90%，達到約 1,300 億美元，高於 LSEG 統計的分析師平均預估 1,251 億美元。
輝達臨時執行長兼財務長Colette Kress在財報新聞中表示，「我們的成長動能真實且強勁。輝達是一家卓越的科技領導企業，仰賴全體員工不懈創新，持續推動發展。Vera Rubin 平台一推出便展現強勁氣勢，我們的產品發展藍圖正按計畫推進，公司的企圖心也從未如此高昂。」

FY 2027 Q4 財測：


營收： 預計為 1,300 億美元，上下浮動 3%。輝達在財測中並未納入任何來自中國市場的資料中心運算業務營收。
毛利率： GAAP 及非 GAAP 毛利率預計介於 71% 至 72%。
營業費用： GAAP 及非 GAAP 營業費用預計分別約為 110 億美元及 107 億美元。


斥資數十億美元採購記憶體並承租資料中心

輝達為確保晶片及系統零組件供應所承擔的採購承諾，從前一期間的 2,790 億美元增加至 3,900 億美元。公司在財報說明中表示，大幅增加主要與多年期記憶體供應採購有關。
輝達的資料中心租賃承諾及雲端服務協議金額達 1,020 億美元，高於上一季的 740 億美元。
Kress 表示，「我們即將開始的資料中心租約，租期最長可達 20 年，目前尚未正式生效。預計這些租約將於 2027 會計年度第四季至 2033 會計年度期間陸續開始生效。我們未來可能將部分租約轉讓給第三方。」

截至2032年對新雲業者的承諾達320億美元

輝達表示，公司正協助新雲業者(neoclouds)及先進 AI 實驗室取得發展所需的土地、電力及資料中心容量，以支持業務擴張。此外，在符合特定條件的情況下，除了產品初期銷售收入外，輝達未來也可能分享新雲業者所創造的營收。
輝達在財務長說明中表示，「只有在新雲業者成功取得融資、用以購買資料中心基礎設施產品，且相關運算容量完成部署、正式投入營運並經由我們驗收後，我們的承諾才會生效。」
根據公司聲明，輝達董事會2026 年 9 月批准將公司股票回購授權額度增加1,500億美元，且該授權沒有到期日。在第三季，輝達透過股票回購及現金股利，總計向股東返還 281 億美元。截至第三季底，公司股票回購授權尚餘約 2,273 億美元。
輝達將於 2026 年 12 月 23 日發放下一季現金股利，每股 0.25 美元，股利發放對象為截至 2026 年 12 月 2 日登記的全體股東。
輝達股價本月下跌 24%，上週五更寫下連續第六週收跌紀錄，創 2012 年以來最長連跌週數。本週前兩個交易日，股價也持續走低，目前來到 2025 年 7 月以來最低。除了黃仁勳相關風波外，輝達還面臨市場對 AI 產業成長放緩的普遍疑慮，以及本月美國期中選舉後華府政治局勢轉變所帶來的影響。
輝達在財報新聞稿及補充資料中完全沒有提及黃仁勳。目前輝達面臨的最大不確定因素，來自中國市場業務。此前，黃仁勳被報導與一名商界女性有婚外情，而該女性據稱是中國間諜，使相關爭議進一步擴大。美國商務部週一宣布政策調整，將全面禁止輝達晶片出租給中國企業，使公司營收面臨風險。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results (ended Oct. 25) after market close on Tuesday the 17th, posting earnings and revenue that both topped analysts’ forecasts and providing a robust outlook. This was the first earnings release since co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO last week. Following the announcement, Nvidia’s stock rose about 2% in after‑hours trading.
Nvidia’s inaugural chairman Harvey Jones said at the start of the earnings call that the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive.

Key Q3 figures versus LSEG estimates:

Revenue: $115.84 billion vs. $109.1 billion forecast
Adjusted EPS: $2.68 vs. $2.48 forecast
Data‑center revenue: $107.6 billion, up 110% YoY
Vera Rubin NVL72 has begun shipping

Nvidia noted that revenue more than doubled from $57.0 billion a year earlier, underscoring the continued strength of its core data‑center business. The company projects Q4 revenue to grow roughly 90% to about $130 billion, above the LSEG consensus of $125.1 billion.

Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress said in the earnings release, “Our growth momentum is real and strong. Nvidia is an outstanding technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of all our employees. The Vera Rubin platform made a powerful debut, our product roadmap is on track, and the company’s ambition has never been higher.”

FY 2027 Q4 outlook:

Revenue: expected $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. The forecast excludes any data‑center revenue from the China market.
Gross margin: GAAP and non‑GAAP margins projected between 71% and 72%.
Operating expenses: GAAP and non‑GAAP operating costs expected to be about $11 billion and $10.7 billion respectively.

Nvidia has increased its procurement commitments for chips and system components from $279 billion in the prior period to $390 billion, reflecting a major expansion of long‑term memory purchases to secure supply.
Nvidia’s data‑center leasing commitments and cloud‑service agreements total $102 billion, up from $74 billion in the prior quarter.

Kress added, “We are about to commence data‑center leases with terms as long as 20 years, which have not yet become effective. These leases are expected to start rolling out from Q4 FY2027 through FY2033. We may later assign portions of these leases to third parties.”

Commitments to new cloud providers through 2032 amount to $32 billion.

Nvidia said it is helping emerging cloud operators (neoclouds) and advanced AI labs secure land, power and data‑center capacity to support expansion. Under certain conditions, beyond early product sales, Nvidia could also share in the revenue generated by these new cloud players.

The CFO explained, “Our commitments only become effective once a new cloud provider successfully raises financing to purchase our data‑center infrastructure products, deploys the compute capacity, puts it into operation and receives our acceptance.”

According to a company statement, Nvidia’s board approved in September 2026 an increase of $150 billion to the stock‑repurchase authorization, with no expiration date. In Q3, Nvidia returned a total of $28.1 billion to shareholders through buybacks and cash dividends. As of the end of Q3, roughly $227.3 billion of the repurchase authorization remained unused.
Nvidia will pay its next quarterly cash dividend on Dec. 23, 2026, $0.25 per share, to shareholders of record as of Dec. 2, 2026.

Nvidia’s share price has fallen 24% this month and recorded a sixth consecutive week of declines last Friday—the longest losing streak since 2012. Over the past two trading days the stock has continued to slide to its lowest level since July 2025. In addition to the turmoil surrounding Jensen Huang, Nvidia faces broader market concerns about slowing AI‑industry growth and the impact of shifting U.S. political dynamics after this month’s mid‑term elections.

The earnings release and supplemental materials made no mention of Jensen Huang. The biggest uncertainty for Nvidia now stems from its China business. Earlier reports linked Huang to an alleged extramarital affair with a businesswoman purported to be a Chinese spy, amplifying the controversy. On Monday, the U.S. Commerce Department announced a policy change that will outright ban the rental of Nvidia chips to Chinese firms, posing a revenue risk for the company.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉油輪遇襲、美國原油庫存料下降 原油上漲 唯供應過剩壓力縮限漲幅
items.title_en: After‑hours Energy: Oil Tanker Attacked, US Crude Inventories Expected to Fall, Crude Rises but Oversupply Limits Gains
paras: 美伊衝突再度升溫，荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲事件加劇市場對原油供應中斷的憂慮，加上市場預期美國原油庫存將下降，國際油價周二 (17日) 收高。不過，中東原油出口逐步恢復，加上國際能源總署 (IEA) 預測第四季全球原油市場將轉為供應過剩，限制油價漲幅。
布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨上漲70美分，漲幅0.76%，收在每桶93.14美元；美國西德州中質原油 (WTI) 期貨上漲29美分，漲幅0.34%，收在每桶86.01美元。不過，兩大指標油價本月仍分別下跌約20%及16%，反映市場對供應增加的預期持續壓抑油價。
中東局勢方面，伊朗周二出動無人機攻擊巴林境內的美軍雷達系統，荷姆茲海峽另有船隻遭到兩度攻擊，船員下落不明。美軍同日對伊朗發動新一輪空襲，鎖定位於格什姆島 (Qeshm Island) 的飛彈發射設施，作為伊朗攻擊美軍人員及資產的報復行動。
美國總統川普周二表示，美方正嚴肅看待伊朗可能策畫在華盛頓發動所謂「髒彈」攻擊的可能性。美伊雙方持續互相報復，使中東衝突進一步升高，也讓全球重要石油運輸通道的安全風險再度受到市場關注。
日本瑞穗銀行 (Mizuho Financial Group) 能源期貨主管鮑伯·亞格 (Bob Yawger) 表示，美伊雙方的報復性攻擊使緊張氣氛持續升高，但全球原油市場可能出現供應過剩的前景，抵銷部分地緣政治風險帶來的支撐。他指出，市場已不再出現先前那種大幅度的油價波動。
國際能源總署上周五指出，隨著中東原油出口恢復速度快於全球需求增長，全球原油市場預計將在今年第四季重新陷入供應過剩。中東海灣地區出口商的原油運輸量已逐步回升至美以對伊朗開戰前的水準附近，市場對供應短缺的憂慮因此有所緩解。
原油運輸成本大幅下降，也反映市場對海上運輸風險的溢價正在消退。PVM石油分析師塔馬斯·瓦爾加 (Tamas Varga) 表示，目前Brent油價正處於區間震盪，市場同時面臨兩股相反力量，一方認為中東原油供應即將增加，另一方則持續關注戰事可能造成的供應中斷風險。
另一方面，葉門親伊朗的胡塞武裝周二聲稱，已出動5架無人機，攻擊位於沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德地區、攸關石油運輸的東西向輸油管線沿線兩座抽油站。隨著胡塞武裝本月多次宣稱攻擊這條輸油管線，中東能源設施與替代運輸路線的安全風險持續升高。
美國原油庫存數據也成為市場另一項關注焦點。美國石油協會 (API) 預計於周二20時30分GMT公布每周庫存報告，美國能源資訊署 (EIA) 則將於周三公布官方數據。路透社調查顯示，市場預期美國原油庫存將下降，為油價提供一定支撐。
此外，美國能源部數據顯示，截至上周，美國戰略石油儲備 (SPR) 庫存已降至2億7,640萬桶，創1982年8月以來最低水準。近期庫存下降與美國承諾釋出1億7,200萬桶戰略石油儲備的計畫有關，也意味著美國應對突發供應中斷的緩衝能力持續受到關注。
整體而言，油市目前正處於地緣政治風險與供需基本面拉鋸的局面。荷姆茲海峽航運受阻、能源設施遇襲及美伊軍事衝突，仍可能推升原油風險溢價；但中東出口恢復、第四季供應過剩預期，以及原油運輸成本下降，則使油價難以持續大幅走高。
paras_en: The renewed escalation of the US‑Iran conflict, highlighted by the tanker attack in the Hormuz Strait, heightened market worries about a disruption to crude supply. Coupled with expectations that US crude inventories will fall, international oil prices closed higher on Tuesday (the 17th). However, the gradual recovery of Middle‑East oil exports and the International Energy Agency’s (IEA) forecast that the global oil market will shift to oversupply in Q4 are expected to cap price gains.

Brent crude futures rose 70 cents, or 0.76%, to $93.14 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures gained 29 cents, or 0.34%, to $86.01 a barrel. Nevertheless, both benchmark prices are down roughly 20% and 16% respectively for the month, reflecting market expectations of increasing supply that continue to suppress prices.

On the Middle‑East front, Iran deployed drones on Tuesday to strike US radar installations in Bahrain, and a vessel in the Hormuz Strait was attacked twice, leaving the crew’s whereabouts unknown. The US responded the same day with a new round of airstrikes targeting missile‑launch sites on Qeshm Island, a retaliation for Iran’s attacks on US personnel and assets.

US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that the United States is taking the possibility of an Iranian “dirty bomb” attack on Washington very seriously. Ongoing retaliation between the US and Iran is raising the level of the Middle‑East conflict and bringing renewed market attention to the security risks facing key global oil transport routes.

Bob Yawger, head of energy futures at Japan’s Mizuho Financial Group, said that while retaliatory strikes by both sides keep tension high, the prospect of a global oil‑supply glut could offset some of the support from geopolitical risk. He noted that the market is no longer seeing the large‑scale price swings that characterized earlier periods.

The International Energy Agency noted last Friday that, as Middle‑East oil exports are recovering faster than global demand growth, the world oil market is expected to slip back into oversupply in the fourth quarter of this year. Export volumes from Gulf producers have been gradually climbing back toward pre‑conflict levels, easing concerns about a supply shortage.

According to PVM analyst Tamas Varga, the sharp drop in crude transportation costs also shows that the premium for maritime‑shipping risk is fading. He said Brent is currently trading in a range, with the market pulled by two opposing forces: one side expects Middle‑East supply to increase, while the other remains focused on the risk of supply interruptions from the fighting.

On the other side, Iran‑aligned Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed on Tuesday that they launched five drones against two oil‑pumping stations along the east‑west pipeline corridor in the Riyadh region of Saudi Arabia, a line critical to oil transport. Repeated Houthi claims of attacks on this pipeline this month have kept the security risk for Middle‑East energy facilities and alternative transport routes high.

US crude‑inventory data also became a focal point for the market. The American Petroleum Institute (API) is scheduled to release its weekly inventory report at 20:30 GMT on Tuesday, while the Energy Information Administration (EIA) will publish the official figures on Wednesday. Reuters surveys show the market expects US crude stocks to decline, providing some support to prices.

In addition, US Department of Energy data show that, as of last week, the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) had fallen to 276.4 million barrels, the lowest level since August 1982. The recent drawdown is linked to the US plan to release 172 million barrels from the SPR, underscoring continued scrutiny of America’s buffer capacity for sudden supply shocks.

Overall, the oil market is caught between geopolitical risk and fundamental supply‑demand dynamics. Disruptions in Hormuz shipping, attacks on energy infrastructure and the US‑Iran military clash could lift the crude risk premium, but the rebound in Middle‑East exports, expectations of a Q4 oversupply and lower transportation costs make it difficult for prices to sustain a strong upward trajectory.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: E.Sun Financial Forecasts a Half‑Point Rate Hike by Year‑End, Foxconn to Spend NT$1.45 billion Acquiring Sony Semiconductor’s Automotive Camera Module Business

1.面對美國期中選舉後政經新局與國內資金外流壓力，玉山金控(2884-TW)17日舉行法說會，總經理陳茂欽與財務長程國榮皆認為，受通膨黏性與外資今年狂賣台股3兆元影響，市場實質利率已緊縮2至3碼，台灣央行年底仍具升息半碼的條件；陳茂欽指出，全球沒有一個國家面臨通膨還能勝選，美國川普政府進入「跛鴨期」，未來 2 年施政重心將轉向外交，力拚解決二大戰事以壓低油價與通膨。
2.鴻海(2317-TW)17日宣布，與索尼半導體解決方案公司(SSS)簽署協議，擬以72.4億日元（約新台幣14.5億元）現金收購SSS旗下車載相機模組事業，交易範圍涵蓋相關業務、技術、客戶關係及營運資源，預計在取得相關主管機關核准並完成先決條件後，於2027年4月底前完成交割。
3.台北股市17日大盤上下振盪高達1747.39點，由護國神山台積電(2330-TW)扮演大盤指標個股，大盤則振盪守住4萬點大關，以40092.11點作收，下跌947.97點或2.31%作收，成交值9617.95億元。三大法人今日合計賣超547.25億元。其中，外資今賣超380.93億元。 外資今天並賣超台積電14606張提款321.26億元。
4.美股重挫再度壓抑台股，加權指數17日一開盤又大跌超過1000點，更一度跌至39796點，跌破4萬點大關，但中央銀行力穩外資出走衝擊，再加上國安基金低檔護盤發威，開盤不到15分鐘大盤翻紅，而新台幣開盤最低僅見到32.968元，守住33元心理大關。
5.立法院針對全民普發現金的朝野攻防進入白熱化，國民黨立法院黨團力拚本周五(20日)三讀通過每人普發新台幣 2 萬元，趕在月底地方選舉前完成立法。行政院長卓榮泰17日赴立法院施政總質詢前受訪，針對全民究竟領 1 萬元或 2 萬元的爭議明確表態，重申政院版 AI 紅利普發 1 萬元方案堅持不舉債、不排擠且不違憲原則，呼籲在野黨切勿強行表決。

paras_en: Facing the new political‑economic landscape after the U.S. midterm elections and domestic capital outflows, E.Sun Financial Holding (2884‑TW) held an earnings conference on the 17th. General Manager Chen Mao‑qin and CFO Cheng Kuo‑rong said that due to sticky inflation and foreign investors selling three trillion TWD of Taiwanese stocks this year, real market rates have tightened by 20‑30 basis points, leaving the Central Bank with conditions to raise rates by half a point by year‑end. Chen noted that no country can win an election while battling inflation, and that the Trump administration in the U.S. is entering a “lame‑duck” period, after which policy focus will shift to diplomacy to resolve two wars and lower oil prices and inflation.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced on the 17th that it has signed an agreement with Sony Semiconductor Solutions (SSS) to acquire SSS’s automotive camera module business for 7.24 billion yen (approximately NT$1.45 billion) in cash. The deal includes related businesses, technology, customer relationships and operational resources, and is expected to close by the end of April 2027 pending regulatory approval and fulfillment of conditions.

The Taipei Stock Exchange index fluctuated on the 17th, swinging up to 1,747.39 points, with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330‑TW) serving as the market’s benchmark stock. The index held above the 40,000‑point level, closing at 40,092.11 points, down 947.97 points or 2.31%, with a turnover of NT$961.795 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a combined NT$54.725 billion today, including foreign investors who sold NT$38.093 billion and withdrew NT$32.126 billion (14,606 lots) from TSMC.

U.S. equity market losses again weighed on Taiwan stocks, and the weighted index opened on the 17th with a drop of more than 1,000 points, briefly falling to 39,796 points and breaking below the 40,000‑point threshold. However, the central bank’s actions steadied the market against foreign outflows, and the National Security Fund’s low‑level support helped the index turn positive within 15 minutes of opening. The New Taiwan dollar opened as low as NT$32.968 per US$ but held above the NT$33 psychological level.

The Legislative Yuan’s debate over a universal cash payout has intensified. The Kuomintang caucus is pushing to pass a third‑reading bill this Friday (the 20th) to grant every citizen NT$20,000 before the end‑of‑month local elections. Premier Chuo Jung‑tai was interviewed on the 17th before his policy address to the Yuan and took a clear stance on the controversy over whether the payout should be NT$10,000 or NT$20,000, reiterating that the administration’s AI‑benefit plan of NT$10,000 will be debt‑free, non‑discriminatory and constitutional, and urging opposition parties not to force a vote.

E.Sun Financial earnings briefing: Chen Mao‑qin sees the Trump administration’s “lame‑duck” domestic period shifting to diplomatic efforts to curb inflation and estimates a modest half‑point rate hike by year‑end.
Foxconn plans to spend NT$1.45 billion to acquire Sony Semiconductor’s automotive camera module business, strengthening its integration of automotive electronic systems.
Foreign investors continued to sell NT$38 billion today and withdrew NT$32.1 billion from TSMC, while buying 24,700 lots of Zhongding.
The central bank and the National Security Fund effectively teamed up to combat foreign capital outflows, turning the Taiwan market red and keeping it above the 40,000‑point mark.
Universal payout of NT$10,000 or NT$20,000? The Legislative Yuan pushes for a third‑reading vote on Friday; Premier Chuo reiterates the NT$10,000 plan is “debt‑free and constitutional.”
Consumer trend: Eating out will become more expensive as the five major brands of Wang Cheng raise prices starting next week.
TSMC praised 35 excellent suppliers, adding Taiwan firms Han‑Tang, Siliconware Precision Industries and Pegatron to the list.
The Financial Supervisory Commission released a list of six “too‑big‑to‑fail” banks, unchanged for seven years, all meeting capital requirements fully.
Bellwether plans to go public; its EPS reached a record high of NT$34.61 in the first three quarters.
Research firm Yan‑Yang’s BB rating held steady at 1.5, order flow remains healthy, and it targets NT$4 billion in quarterly revenue for next year.
Taiwan’s large‑size photomask and silicon‑photonics applications are gradually scaling up, with revenue expected to grow about 20% year‑over‑year next year.

items.title: 華航公益棒球營 攜手這4位旅外球星傳承棒球夢
items.title_en: China Airlines Charity Baseball Camp Teams Up with Four Overseas Players to Pass On Baseball Dreams
paras: 華航(2610-TW)長期深耕基層體育發展，今(17)日於屏東糖廠棒壘球場舉辦第七屆公益棒球營，由董事長高星潢與資深副總經理羅雅美共同揭開活動序幕，並邀請旅外球星鄭宗哲、陳柏毓、林家正和林昱珉組成豪華教練團，陪伴來自屏東縣鶴聲國中、里港國中和高泰國中共120位小球員展開一日棒球訓練交流，將寶貴經驗傳承給下一代。
華航秉持「飛更遠，愛無限（Flying beyond, Caring more）」核心理念，本屆公益棒球營特別選在屏東舉辦，高星潢表示，期盼透過企業力量支持基層體育，為年輕選手創造更多成長機會。
此次活動除安排專業訓練課程外，也特別捐贈訓練球予參與學校。
身為屏東縣鶴聲國中校友的鄭宗哲回到母校授課感觸良多表示，站在學弟們每天練習的場地上，彷彿看見昔日努力的自己，很感謝華航攜手返鄉回饋家鄉，也希望透過自身經驗鼓勵孩子們相信自己、勇敢追夢。
公益棒球營課程內容豐富多元，鄭宗哲、陳柏毓、林家正和林昱珉親自示範棒球動作要領，協助小球員強化基本功與實戰能力，現場安排成果驗收活動，由球星們親自帶隊進行模擬實戰對抗，讓學員將當天所學應用於比賽情境中，感受職業球員的訓練與比賽氛圍。
隨後舉辦分享會和Q&A交流環節，四位選手和小球員分享旅外經驗及心路歷程；陳柏毓勉勵小球員，享受棒球、不要害怕重複練習，基本功越穩固、上場就越有自信；林家正則鼓勵孩子們勇於嘗試不同守備位置，給自己更多機會發掘適合的舞台；林昱珉認為，棒球之路難免會遇到挑戰與挫折，但只要保持熱情並持續努力，每一次練習都會成為成長的養分。
華航多年來推動公益棒球營、籃球營、羽球營、桌球營等運動扎根計畫，結合企業資源和運動明星影響力，陪伴更多孩子拓展視野、朝夢想邁進；同時，舉辦華航馬拉松星光夜跑，以創新多元方式推廣全民運動。
華航強調，將持續發揮企業影響力，深化環境永續、社會關懷等面向，攜手各界創造更多公益價值，為社會帶來更多溫暖與正向力量。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) has long been devoted to grassroots sports development. Today (the 17th) it held the 7th Charity Baseball Camp at the Pingtung Sugar Factory baseball field, with Chairman Gao Xinghuang and senior vice‑president Luo Yamei opening the event. Four overseas players – Zheng Zongzhe, Chen Baiyu, Lin Jiazheng and Lin Yumin – formed a star‑studded coaching team to guide 120 young players from Hesheng Junior High, Ligang Junior High and Gaotai Junior High in Pingtung County through a day of baseball training and exchange, passing on valuable experience to the next generation.

China Airlines upholds its core philosophy “Flying beyond, Caring more,” and chose Pingtung for this year’s camp. Chairman Gao said the aim is to leverage corporate strength to support grassroots sports and create more growth opportunities for young athletes.
In addition to professional training sessions, the event also donated training balls to the participating schools.

Zheng Zongzhe, an alumnus of Hesheng Junior High in Pingtung County, returned to his alma mater to teach and expressed deep emotion. He said standing on the field where his juniors practice feels like seeing his younger self’s hard work. He thanked China Airlines for partnering to give back to his hometown and hopes his experience will encourage the kids to believe in themselves and bravely chase their dreams.

The camp’s curriculum was rich and varied. Zheng, Chen, Lin Jiazheng and Lin Yumin demonstrated baseball techniques, helping the youngsters strengthen fundamentals and game skills. A results‑verification activity was arranged on site, with the stars leading simulated games so participants could apply what they learned in a match setting and feel the training and competition atmosphere of professional players.

A sharing session and Q&A followed, where the four players and the youngsters discussed overseas experiences and personal journeys. Chen urged the kids to enjoy baseball and not fear repetitive practice, noting that solid fundamentals boost confidence on the field. Lin Jiazheng encouraged trying different defensive positions to discover the best fit, while Lin Yumin said the baseball path inevitably brings challenges, but maintaining passion and continual effort turns every practice into growth nourishment.

For years China Airlines has promoted charity camps for baseball, basketball, badminton, table tennis and other sports, combining corporate resources with the influence of sports stars to help more children broaden their horizons and pursue their dreams. It also hosts the China Airlines Marathon Star‑Light Night Run, using innovative, diverse methods to promote mass fitness.

China Airlines emphasizes that it will continue to wield its corporate influence to deepen environmental sustainability, social care and other areas, partnering with all sectors to create greater public‑benefit value, bringing more warmth and positive energy to society.

items.title: 堵中國算力繞道！美BIS晶片禁令19日生效 經部表態了！曝台廠代工申請關鍵
items.title_en: U.S. BIS Chip Ban Takes Effect on the 19th, Blocking China’s Compute Detour; Taiwan Ministry Responds, Reveals Key OEM Application
paras: 美國商務部工業暨安全局（BIS）於11月16日發布先進超級智慧（SI）晶片與伺服器遠端存取出口管制臨時最終規則草案，預計11月19日正式生效，全面防堵中國客戶透過第三國資料中心獲取雲端算力。對此，經濟部今（17）日表示，台灣半導體及AI伺服器業者主要依客戶訂單提供代工服務，若出口產品涉及美方新規定，將由下單的美國客戶向BIS提出出口許可證申請，經濟部也會持續協助國內業者落實法規遵循。
隨著人工智慧技術快速演進，美國政府為防止敏感運算技術外流，持續升級對中國的科技圍堵網。過往美方主要管制高階AI晶片與伺服器直接輸往中國，或是中國企業在海外子公司的資料中心，但近期發現有業者藉由第三國資料中心提供遠端雲端算力服務來規避禁令，促使美方決定大舉擴大管制範圍並限縮相關豁免條款。
針對美方最新發布的管制措施，經濟部指出，台美雙方長期就出口管制、供應鏈安全及經濟安全等重要議題保持密切對話，雙方更於今年2月正式簽訂對等貿易協定，承諾進一步強化在出口管制領域的合作。面對美國政府本次推出新規以彌補潛在的管制漏洞，經濟部將持續與美方針對具體管制作法深入交換意見，攜手共同防堵任何違規轉運行為，確保全球科技供應鏈的安全與穩定。
檢視本次美國商務部發布的新規細節，管制力道主要有三大升級重點。首先在擴大管制方面，針對提供雲端算力服務給中國客戶的第三國資料中心，未來出口先進晶片至這類雲端運算用途的資料中心，均須事先取得許可。其次，本案增列5個高轉運風險國家的許可證要求，未來向印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國等4個東協國家以及巴西出口先進晶片，皆須依法申請出口許可。
此外，新規也大幅限縮晶圓製造廠及封測廠（OSAT）的豁免審查空間。過往經美國商務部核准的晶圓製造與封測大廠，可享有豁免申請晶片出口許可的待遇，但未來即便已獲核准，只要前端晶片設計商位於中國、印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國或巴西等地，將不再適用該項許可豁免，必須一體適用管制晶片規定並事先申請出口許可。經濟部強調，將持續掌握美方執行細節並舉辦宣導活動，提醒台廠留意法規調整。
paras_en: On November 16, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) released a draft of the final interim rules for export controls on advanced superintelligence (SI) chips and remote server access, slated to take effect on November 19. The rules aim to fully block Chinese customers from obtaining cloud compute power via third‑country data centers. In response, Taiwan’s Ministry of Economic Affairs said on the 17th that Taiwanese semiconductor and AI server firms mainly provide foundry services based on customer orders; if exported products fall under the new U.S. regulations, the U.S. customer placing the order will apply for an export license from BIS, and the ministry will continue to help domestic firms comply with the rules.

As AI technology rapidly evolves, the U.S. government is continuously tightening its tech containment network against China to prevent the leakage of sensitive computing capabilities. Previously, U.S. controls focused on direct shipments of high‑end AI chips and servers to China or to data centers of Chinese subsidiaries abroad. Recently, however, authorities discovered that some firms were offering remote cloud compute services through third‑country data centers to evade the ban, prompting the U.S. to dramatically broaden the scope of controls and narrow related exemption clauses.

Regarding the latest U.S. measures, the Ministry of Economic Affairs noted that Taiwan and the United States have long maintained close dialogue on export controls, supply‑chain security, and economic security, and that the two sides signed a reciprocal trade agreement in February this year to further strengthen cooperation in export control matters. Facing the new U.S. rules designed to close potential loopholes, the ministry will keep exchanging detailed views with the U.S. on specific regulatory implementations, working together to block any illicit transshipment and ensure the safety and stability of the global technology supply chain.

A review of the new BIS regulations shows three major upgrades in control intensity. First, the export of advanced chips to third‑country data centers that provide cloud compute services to Chinese customers will now require prior permission. Second, the rule adds license‑requirement obligations for five high‑risk transshipment countries; exports of advanced chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil will all need to obtain an export license under the law.

Finally, the new rules sharply narrow the exemption space for wafer foundries and OSATs. Previously, large wafer‑fab and packaging firms approved by the U.S. Commerce Department could enjoy exemption from chip‑export licensing. Under the new regime, even approved firms will lose that exemption if the front‑end chip designer is located in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil, and must instead comply with the full control regime and obtain a license in advance. The ministry emphasized it will keep track of U.S. implementation details and hold outreach activities to remind Taiwanese companies of the regulatory changes.

items.title: 台股續跌險守4萬關 證交所連二日信心喊話：基本面穩健、追繳風險可控
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Slip Below 40,000 Points; Exchange Calls for Confidence: Fundamentals Solid, Margin Call Risks Manageable
paras: 受市場對AI產業前景疑慮拖累，台股今(17)日隨國際主要股市同步震盪，加權股價指數終場重挫947.97點，跌幅2.31%，以40,092.11點作收，險守4萬點大關。面對市場恐慌情緒，證交所連續第二天發布新聞稿向市場信心喊話，強調國際金融機構仍看好AI中長期發展，且國內上市公司前三季獲利暴增逾八成、信用交易風險可控，呼籲投資人回歸基本面理性判斷。
證交所指出，針對近期科技股修正，瑞銀集團(UBS)認為主要反映投資部位調整而非AI投資循環結束，持續看好結構性成長機會；摩根大通私人銀行看好未來12至18個月大型雲端業者前景，預期AI長期將帶動生產力與經濟成長；貝萊德(BlackRock)則對AI長期發展潛力維持樂觀。
在信用交易風險方面，截至16日全市場信用交易擔保維持率仍達165.98%，遠高於130%的最低追繳門檻。目前追繳戶數733戶，追繳與處分金額分別為3.97億元與5.67億元，相較大盤成交金額占比極低。證交所強調，與去年4月美國對等關稅事件相比，現階段市場追繳壓力相對和緩，處分規模與人數均在安全範圍內，整體交易秩序正常。
根據證交所統計，今年前三季本國上市公司(不含金控及未申報公司)累計營收達45兆4,758億元，年增38.29%；稅前淨利達6兆2,273億元，年增82.69%，呈現營收與獲利雙雙大幅成長的亮眼格局。全市場具獲利之上市公司達872家(約占81%)，獲利較去年同期成長者達775家(約占72%)。
從產業別觀察，半導體業憑藉領先技術掌握AI商機；電腦及周邊設備業受惠雲端業者擴大AI基礎建設；電子零組件業則受AI伺服器及高效能運算需求帶動，獲利全面走揚。此外，玻璃陶瓷及塑膠工業亦受惠相關需求，由去年同期虧損轉為獲利，顯示AI產業成長效益已擴散至其他產業。
證交所強調，目前台股信用交易維持率充足，企業營運成果亦展現成長動能，面對短期國際股市波動，投資人應審慎評估自身風險承受能力、留意槓桿交易風險，並回歸企業基本面理性判斷，共同維護資本市場長期穩健發展。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market fell today (the 17th) in line with major international indices as concerns over the AI industry's outlook weighed on sentiment. The weighted index closed down 947.97 points, a 2.31% drop, at 40,092.11 points, just shy of the 40,000‑point threshold. Facing market panic, the exchange issued a second consecutive press release urging confidence, stressing that international financial institutions remain bullish on AI’s medium‑to‑long‑term prospects, domestic listed companies posted more than an 80% profit surge in the first three quarters, and margin‑trading risks are under control, urging investors to return to fundamentals for rational judgment.

The exchange noted that recent tech‑stock corrections are, according to UBS, mainly a portfolio rebalancing rather than the end of the AI investment cycle, and it continues to see structural growth opportunities. JPMorgan private banking is optimistic about large cloud providers over the next 12‑18 months, expecting AI to drive productivity and economic growth in the long run. BlackRock also maintains a positive outlook on AI’s long‑term development potential.

Regarding margin‑trading risk, as of the 16th the market‑wide margin‑maintenance ratio remained at 165.98%, well above the 130% minimum margin‑call threshold. There are currently 733 margin‑call accounts, with margin‑call and penalty amounts of NT$397 million and NT$567 million respectively, a tiny share of total market turnover. The exchange emphasized that, compared with the U.S. tariff‑equivalence episode in April last year, current margin‑call pressure is relatively mild, with both the scale and number of penalties within safe limits and overall trading order normal.

According to exchange data, domestic listed companies (excluding financial holding companies and unreported firms) generated cumulative revenue of NT$45.4758 trillion in the first three quarters of this year, up 38.29% year‑on‑year, and pre‑tax net profit reached NT$6.2273 trillion, up 82.69%, showcasing a striking pattern of strong revenue and profit growth. A total of 872 listed companies (about 81% of the market) were profitable, and 775 of them (about 72%) posted higher earnings than the same period last year.

Sector‑wise, the semiconductor industry is capitalising on AI opportunities with its leading technology; the computer and peripheral equipment sector benefits from cloud providers expanding AI infrastructure; electronic components are buoyed by demand for AI servers and high‑performance computing, driving profit gains across the board. Moreover, the glass‑ceramic and plastics industries have turned from losses to profits thanks to related demand, indicating that AI‑driven growth benefits are spreading to other sectors.

The exchange stressed that Taiwan’s margin‑maintenance ratio remains ample and corporate operating results demonstrate growth momentum. Facing short‑term international market volatility, investors should carefully assess their risk tolerance, watch for leverage‑trading risks, and revert to rational, fundamentals‑based judgments to jointly safeguard the long‑term, healthy development of the capital market.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Exchange Q3 Financial Report Review Released: Li Ming and Zheng Feng to Switch to Full Delivery from Nov 19, Tai Yang Delisted Dec 21
paras: 臺灣證券交易所於今(17)日公布上市公司2026年第3季財務報告形式審閱結果與相關處置情形。其中，正峰(1538-TW)因會計師出具繼續經營能力存在重大不確定性之核閱報告，上市有價證券將併案列為變更交易方法(全額交割)；力銘(3593-TW)因淨值低於股本十分之三，將繼續列為變更交易方法並加採分盤集合競價交易；而台揚科技(2314-TW)則因淨值轉為負數，先前已公告將於12月21日起終止上市。
證交所表示，本次針對上市公司(扣除金控公司13家因申報期限至11/30外)第3季財報進行形式審閱，相關處置措施將自115年11月19日起正式執行。
正峰工業先前已因符合相關規定遭列為變更交易方法在案；本次因最近期公告申報之財報經會計師出具「繼續經營能力存在重大不確定性」之核閱報告，證交所依規定將其上市有價證券併案列為變更交易方法。
力銘科技先前同樣因故被列為變更交易方法；根據其最新申報之財報顯示，淨值已低於所列示股本的十分之三，因此證交所宣布其有價證券繼續列為變更交易方法，並同步加採行分盤集合競價交易方式。
台揚科技先前已因多項規定被列為變更交易方法並採行分盤集合競價交易。因其最新財報顯示淨值已為負數，符合終止上市規定，證交所先前已正式公告其有價證券將自今年12月21日起終止上市。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced today (the 17th) the results of its formal review of listed companies’ Q3 2026 financial reports and the related actions. Zheng Feng (1538‑TW) received an auditor’s review report indicating a material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern, so its listed securities will be treated as a change of trading method to full delivery; Li Ming (3593‑TW) has net assets less than one‑tenth of its share capital, and will continue to be subject to a change of trading method with the addition of split‑lot collective auction trading; Tai Yang Technology (2314‑TW) now has negative net assets and has previously announced that its listing will be terminated effective December 21.

The exchange noted that this formal review covered Q3 reports of listed companies (excluding 13 financial holding companies whose filing deadline extends to Nov 30). The related measures will take effect starting Nov 19, 2025.

Zheng Feng Industrial had already been designated for a change of trading method under applicable rules. This time, because the most recent filed report included an auditor’s review stating a material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern, the exchange is classifying its listed securities as a case for change of trading method in accordance with regulations.

Li Ming Technology had also previously been placed under a change of trading method. According to its latest filed report, net assets have fallen below one‑tenth of the disclosed share capital, so the exchange announced that its securities will remain under the change‑of‑trading‑method regime and will additionally adopt split‑lot collective auction trading.

Tai Yang Technology had previously been placed under a change of trading method and subject to split‑lot collective auction trading due to several regulatory breaches. Its latest report shows net assets are now negative, meeting the criteria for delisting; the exchange has already formally announced that its securities will be delisted effective Dec 21 this year.

items.title: 鴻海72億日圓收購Sony車載相機模組業務 切入日系車廠供應鏈
items.title_en: Foxconn to Acquire Sony's Automotive Camera Module Business for 7.24 Billion Yen, Entering Japanese Automaker Supply Chain
paras: 2026年11月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 鴻海(2317-TW)宣布，以72.4億日圓（約新台幣15億元）收購日本索尼集團Sony Group(6758-JP)旗下半導體子公司的車載相機模組業務，預計2027年4月底前完成交易。這是鴻海繼2025年收購夏普相機模組業務及越南Saigon STEC後，再度擴大光學零組件布局，並從手機相機模組延伸至車用市場。
鴻海原本就有相機模組業務，相關產品歸屬於「元件及其他產品」事業下的光學類別，涵蓋觸控模組、相機模組及點陣投影機模組等。近年公司透過併購擴大規模，2025年6月由旗下Fullertain承接夏普相機模組業務，同月底再取得越南手機相機模組製造商Saigon STEC全部股權，強化光學零組件的製造與整合能力。
此次收購主要涉及Sony位於泰國的車載相機模組業務，負責將CMOS影像感測器、鏡頭及周邊零組件組裝成相機模組。Sony本身是車用影像感測器供應商，相關模組業務也已建立日本汽車製造商客戶基礎。對鴻海而言，此次交易不只是取得製造技術，也有機會承接既有日系車廠供應關係，擴大汽車電子業務。
車載相機是先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)及車內監控的重要零組件，產業分工涵蓋上游CMOS影像感測器、光學鏡頭、中游模組組裝及下游車用系統整合。Sony的技術優勢主要集中在影像感測器，鴻海則透過承接模組業務，擴大既有電子製造與車用零組件產品線。
不過，72.4億日圓並非最終完整收購成本，部分海外生產設備及存貨尚未納入交易價格，後續若一併取得，總金額可能增加。

paras_en: On November 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Foxconn (2317-TW) announced it will acquire Sony Group's (6758-JP) automotive camera module business, a semiconductor subsidiary, for 7.24 billion yen (about NT$1.5 billion), with the transaction expected to close by the end of April 2027. This follows Foxconn’s 2025 purchase of Sharp’s camera module business and Vietnam’s Saigon STEC, further expanding its optical component portfolio from smartphone camera modules into the automotive market.

Foxconn already operates a camera‑module business under its “Components and Other Products” segment, covering optical categories such as touch modules, camera modules and pico‑projector modules. In recent years the company has grown through acquisitions: in June 2025 its subsidiary Fullertain took over Sharp’s camera‑module business, and later that month it acquired 100% of Vietnam‑based mobile camera‑module maker Saigon STEC, strengthening its manufacturing and integration capabilities for optical components.

The acquisition targets Sony’s automotive camera‑module operation located in Thailand, which assembles CMOS image sensors, lenses and related parts into camera modules. Sony itself is a supplier of automotive image sensors and has already built a customer base among Japanese car manufacturers. For Foxconn, the deal brings not only manufacturing technology but also the chance to inherit existing supply relationships with Japanese automakers, expanding its automotive electronics business.

Automotive cameras are key components for advanced driver‑assistance systems (ADAS) and in‑vehicle monitoring, with the industry chain spanning upstream CMOS sensors, optical lenses, mid‑stream module assembly and downstream vehicle‑system integration. Sony’s technical edge lies mainly in image sensors, while Foxconn will leverage the module‑assembly business to broaden its existing electronics manufacturing and automotive component product lines.

However, the 7.24 billion yen price does not represent the final total cost; some overseas production equipment and inventory have not yet been included in the transaction price, and the overall amount could increase if those assets are later acquired.

items.title: 櫃買爆2檔違約交割逾6500萬元 千金股旺矽今年二度上榜
items.title_en: OTC Market Reports Two Default Deliveries Exceeding NT$65 Million; High‑Priced Stock Wan‑Silicon Listed Twice This Year
paras: 櫃買中心今(17)日公告，上櫃新增 2 起個股違約交割通報，分別為測試介面千金股旺矽(6223-TW)及太陽能網版廠倉和(6538-TW)，合計違約金額達6,502.1萬元；這也是今年以來櫃買市場累計的第17及第18起違約交割案件。
根據櫃買中心公布資料，旺矽此次違約交割金額高達5,406萬元，由臺銀金山、德信、新光等三家券商分點通報；倉和違約交割金額則為1,096.1萬元，通報券商分點包括華南台南、永豐潮州及永豐桃園。
值得留意的是，高價股旺矽今年已非首度發生違約交割。回顧今年6月12日，旺矽便曾由永豐金證券萬盛分公司通報違約交割1,207萬元；加計今日通報的5,406萬元後，旺矽今年以來累計違約交割金額已達6,613萬元。
依據台股「T+2」交割制度回推，17日通報的違約交割，其交易發生日為13日。觀察上周五兩檔個股盤面表現，走勢皆出現劇烈震盪，成為引爆違約的關鍵。
其中，旺矽13日以4,910元開高後，盤中一度衝上5,100元高點，但隨後賣壓湧現、股價大幅拉回，盤中最低下探至4,630元，高低點震幅逾一成，終場僅小漲15元、收在4,670元，漲幅0.32%；倉和13日同樣開高走低，早盤以337元開出，最高觸及338元後反轉急殺，盤中直接打入跌停價293.5元並鎖死至終場，重挫32.5元、跌幅達9.97%。
市場人士分析，兩檔個股當日均出現「開高走低」的急殺走勢，導致追高搶短或當沖做多的投資人措手不及，一旦未備足交割款項，便在今日爆發大額違約交割。
提醒投資人，從事有價證券交易時，應審慎評估自身財務狀況與交割能力，避免過度擴張信用進行高槓桿或當沖操作，以免因無法如期履行交割義務，面臨信用受損及相關法律責任。
paras_en: The OTC Center announced today (the 17th) that two new individual stock default deliveries have been reported on the over‑the‑counter market, involving test‑interface high‑priced stock Wan‑Silicon (6223‑TW) and solar‑panel manufacturer Cang‑He (6538‑TW), with a combined default amount of NT$65.021 million; these are the 17th and 18th default delivery cases recorded in the OTC market this year.

According to data released by the OTC Center, Wan‑Silicon’s default delivery amount reached NT$54.06 million, reported by three broker branches: Taiwan Bank Jinshan, Deshin, and Shin Kong; Cang‑He’s default amount was NT$10.961 million, reported by broker branches including Hua Nan Tainan, Yong‑Feng Chaozhou, and Yong‑Feng Taoyuan.

It is noteworthy that high‑priced stock Wan‑Silicon has already experienced a default delivery earlier this year. Looking back to June 12, Wan‑Silicon was reported by Yong‑Feng Securities’ Wansheng branch for a default delivery of NT$12.07 million; adding today’s reported NT$54.06 million brings Wan‑Silicon’s cumulative default delivery amount for the year to NT$66.13 million.

Based on Taiwan’s T+2 settlement system, the default deliveries reported on the 17th originated from trades executed on the 13th. Observing the market performance of the two stocks last Friday, both showed extreme volatility, which was the key trigger for the defaults.

On the 13th, Wan‑Silicon opened high at NT$4,910 and briefly surged to a peak of NT$5,100, but then faced heavy selling pressure, pulling back sharply to a low of NT$4,630—a price swing of over 10%. It closed with a modest gain of NT$15 at NT$4,670, up 0.32%. Cang‑He also opened high and fell, starting at NT$337, reaching a high of NT$338 before reversing sharply, plunging to the daily limit down price of NT$293.5 and staying there until the close, a drop of NT$32.5 or 9.97%.

Market analysts say that both stocks exhibited a “open high, close low” rapid decline on the day, catching investors who chased the rally or engaged in day‑trading long positions off guard; lacking sufficient settlement funds, they triggered large default deliveries today.

Investors are reminded that when trading securities, they should carefully assess their own financial condition and settlement capability, avoid over‑extending credit for high‑leverage or day‑trading activities, and ensure they can meet settlement obligations to prevent credit damage and related legal liabilities.

items.title: 黃仁勳聽證會前夕添變數！Muddy Waters放空輝達、追問前高層與美超微晶片分配疑雲
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Faces New Variables Ahead of Hearing! Muddy Waters Shorts Nvidia, Questions Former Execs and AMD Chip Allocation Cloud
paras: 做空機構Muddy Waters披露放空輝達(NVDA-US)倉位，並公開質疑輝達前高層Ajay K. Puri與美超微電腦(SMCI-US)前首席業務增長官(CGO)Cenly Chen之間是否存在關聯，令這家晶片巨頭面臨新一輪外部壓力。
Muddy Waters 週二(17日)在社交平台X上發布貼文，指出該機構已建立輝達放空部位。
貼文指出，在2024年至2026年間，一位名叫Cenly Chen（在某些照片標籤中被稱為Cenly Puri）的女性，多次與輝達前高層Ajay K. Puri在公開場合被拍到同框。
Muddy Waters提出的核心疑問是：這位與Puri關係密切的女性，是否就是曾在美超微擔任首席業務增長官(CGO)的Cenly Chen？
這項披露發生於輝達動盪時期。執行長黃仁勳於11月12日辭職，並已同意於12月1日就相關問題回應三個眾議院委員會的質詢；輝達總法律顧問Tim Teter則定於次日出席。
要理解Muddy Waters為何緊盯這條線索，必須先看看這兩位人物在各自公司的分量：Ajay K. Puri在2026年6月離職前，擔任輝達全球業務營運執行副總裁(EVP of Worldwide Field Operations)。
Muddy Waters指出，Puri當時很可能是輝達內部僅次於黃仁勳和財務長Colette Kress的「三號人物」。在2024至2026財年間，他的總薪酬甚至略高於財務長Kress。即使在今年6月卸下該職務後，他仍繼續擔任輝達的高級顧問。
至於美超微前首席業務增長官Cenly Chen，正是負責管理美超微向輝達採購GPU晶片的核心人物，並且「決定如何將這些輝達GPU分配給美超微的客戶」。她已於2026年4月底或5月初離開美超微。
如果輝達的「首席銷售官」和美超微的「首席採購與分配官」之間存在未披露的密切關係，無疑將引發市場對兩家公司交易透明度的重大疑慮。
一邊是掌握輝達晶片出貨大權的高層，一邊是被指稱涉及相關安排的美超微前高層。在這個節骨眼上，Muddy Waters拋出的「高層關係疑雲」，無疑為即將到來的聽證會增添極為敏感的議題。
按照日程安排，剛辭去執行長職務的黃仁勳已同意於12月1日出席三個眾議院委員會的聽證會並回答質詢。緊接著在12月2日，輝達總法律顧問Tim Teter也將出庭作證。
paras_en: Short‑seller Muddy Waters disclosed a short position in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and publicly questioned whether former Nvidia executive Ajay K. Puri and former AMD (SMCI‑US) chief growth officer Cenly Chen have any connection, putting the chip giant under a new wave of external pressure.
Muddy Waters posted on X on Tuesday (the 17th) that the firm has established a short position in Nvidia.

The post noted that between 2024 and 2026, a woman named Cenly Chen (identified in some photo tags as Cenly Puri) was photographed multiple times together with former Nvidia executive Ajay K. Puri at public events.
Muddy Waters’ core question is whether this woman, who is close to Puri, is the same person who served as chief growth officer (CGO) at AMD, Cenly Chen.

The disclosure comes during a turbulent period for Nvidia. CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12 and has agreed to respond to three House committees on December 1; Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter is scheduled to appear the following day.

To understand why Muddy Waters is focusing on this lead, one must look at the stature of the two individuals at their respective companies: Ajay K. Puri, before leaving in June 2026, was EVP of Worldwide Field Operations at Nvidia.

Muddy Waters points out that Puri was likely the third‑most senior person at Nvidia after Huang and CFO Colette Kress. In fiscal years 2024‑2026 his total compensation was even slightly higher than CFO Kress’s. Even after stepping down from the role in June this year, he remains a senior advisor to Nvidia.

As for former AMD chief growth officer Cenly Chen, she was the key person responsible for managing AMD’s procurement of Nvidia GPU chips and “deciding how to allocate those Nvidia GPUs to AMD’s customers.” She left AMD at the end of April or early May 2026.

If an undisclosed close relationship exists between Nvidia’s “chief sales officer” and AMD’s “chief procurement and allocation officer,” it would undoubtedly raise serious market concerns about the transparency of the two companies’ transactions.

On one side is the senior executive who controls Nvidia’s chip shipments; on the other is the former AMD senior executive alleged to be involved in related arrangements. At this critical moment, Muddy Waters’ “executive‑relationship cloud” adds a highly sensitive issue to the upcoming hearings.

According to the schedule, the newly resigned CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to attend the three House committee hearings on December 1 and answer questions. Immediately after, on December 2, Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter will also testify in court.
